mapper.select: SELECT chapter_id, novel_id, chapter_no, title, is_vip, vip_price, word_count, publish_time FROM chapter WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chapter_no ASC

SELECT c.chapter_id, c.novel_id, n.title AS novel_title, c.chapter_no, c.title, c.content, c.is_vip, c.vip_price, c.word_count, c.publish_time FROM chapter c JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = c.novel_id WHERE c.chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.audit_status = 1 AND c.publish_time IS NOT NULL AND n.audit_status = 1 AND n.status IN (0, 1)

SELECT chapter_id, chapter_no, title FROM chapter WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL AND chapter_no < #{chapterNo} ORDER BY chapter_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT chapter_id, chapter_no, title FROM chapter WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1 AND publish_time IS NOT NULL AND chapter_no > #{chapterNo} ORDER BY chapter_no ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT chapter_id, novel_id, chapter_no, title, is_vip, vip_price, word_count, status, audit_status, publish_time, created_at, updated_at FROM chapter WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} ORDER BY chapter_no ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
